## Purpose

Describe the problem this change addresses.

## Change type

- [ ] Factual correction
- [ ] Source or citation
- [ ] Scope or uncertainty clarification
- [ ] Technical architecture
- [ ] Environmental measurement
- [ ] Security or governance
- [ ] Editorial improvement
- [ ] Repository process

## Evidence

List the strongest relevant sources, data, or reproducible reasoning.

## Counterevidence and limitations

State credible evidence against this change and any geographic, technical, or temporal limits.

## Interests and affiliations

Disclose material employment, funding, ownership, advocacy, or vendor relationships, or write none.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I separated fact, forecast, assumption, proposal, and judgment.
- [ ] I used neutral language and followed the political-neutrality policy.
- [ ] I stated the geographic scope and did not treat one region's result as universal.
- [ ] I identified uncertainty and material counterevidence.
- [ ] I did not include confidential, personal, or unlawfully obtained information.
- [ ] I updated the evidence ledger, decision record, or changelog when material.
